newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Airborne Freight started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Airborne Freight started.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Gary Aster said he began coverage of Airborne Freight Corp with a hold rating.
-- He said while shares have fallen from a high of 38-1/4 in June 1994, the valuation is slightly above Dain's preferred entry point of $25 a share.
-- Airborne Freight shares were up 1/8 at 27-1/4.

-- Airborne Freight, which provides shipping services for business customers, is in the process of establishing European offices and, primarily through joint ventures, is beginning to replace the independent agencies it had previously used for representation.

-- Airborne Freight recently reported fourth quarter earnings declined to $10.7 million or $0.48 per fully diluted share from $11.9 million or $0.56 a share a year ago. The current quarter was impacted by a non-recurring pretax charge of $3.7 million related to the loss of an aircraft.
-- Results for the quarter were favorably effected by improvements in domestic yields, while the international business experienced a slowdown in the quarter.
